correctness.rationale: The proof reduces each infinite gcd to the initial window and the exact gcd of all window differences using strong divisibility of B. The square and sum identities are verified by recurrence; modular arithmetic at 2, the lifting rule nu_3(B_{2m})=1+nu_3(m), and ordinary odd-prime comparison reconstruct all valuations with no finite-to-infinite inference. The package checker independently computes 25 windows per length for each of 300 lengths, and checks initial sums and difference reductions.

value.rationale: A published question asks for explicit square-window GCDs of four connected recurrence sequences. These identities determine three complete infinite families by a common finite arithmetic invariant and prove two previously merely observed equalities, using nontrivial two- and three-adic phenomena. This is a mathematically motivated partial resolution with explicit scope; it does not claim to solve the fourth family or the independent index-divisibility problem.
